limits: No GUI or game was run.
Static editor fixtures are not controller/timing/material/collision/placement acceptance.
No held poses, tilted rack lift, runtime bytes, computer settings, plugins or deployments changed.
Shaker samples are exact keyframes only; Catmull-Rom between-key timing and engine float/query behavior remain unverified.
Source/nested transforms are rigid and all participating nodes have one nonzero axis; no affine/shear approximation is used.
Entity alpha-test and source no-cull are material hints, not proof of shader equivalence.

Entity-helper world yaw is explicitly not simulated. Barrel north routes through facingYaw(0)=180; shaker through facing*90. Body equality is in the documented source-reference/native-codec frame, not an in-world facing acceptance.
